name: IDNYC
who_can_use: New York City residents age 10 and older.
status_note: Immigration status is not asked and not needed.
bring: proof of identity (passport or consular ID)
proof of NYC address (lease, utility bill or letter)
how_to_apply: Make an appointment at an enrollment center and bring your documents.
summary_es: Identificación gratuita de la ciudad. Sirve para la biblioteca, museos y abrir algunas cuentas de banco.
summary_en: Free city ID card. Works for the library, museums and opening some bank accounts.

name: Public library card
who_can_use: Anyone who lives, works or studies in the city.
how_to_apply: Ask at any library branch desk.
summary_es: Tarjeta de biblioteca gratis: libros, computadoras, clases de inglés y ayuda para buscar trabajo.
summary_en: Free library card: books, computers, English classes and job search help.

name: Starter bank account
who_can_use: Adults with an accepted photo ID.
status_note: Some banks and credit unions accept IDNYC or a consular ID; ask before you go.
how_to_apply: Visit a participating bank or credit union branch.
summary_es: Cuenta de banco básica. Es más seguro que guardar efectivo y puede bajar el costo de enviar dinero.
summary_en: Basic bank account. Safer than keeping cash and can lower the cost of sending money home.

name: WIC (food for women, infants and children)
who_can_use: Pregnant people, new parents, and children under 5 with limited income.
status_note: Immigration status does not matter for WIC.
bring: child's health record if you have it
how_to_apply: Call or visit a WIC office for an appointment.
summary_es: Comida saludable, fórmula y consejos de nutrición para embarazadas y niños menores de 5 años.
summary_en: Healthy food, formula and nutrition advice for pregnant people and children under 5.

name: Child Health Plus
who_can_use: Children and teens under 19 in New York State.
status_note: Children can enroll regardless of immigration status.
how_to_apply: Apply with an enrollment helper at a clinic or through the state marketplace.
summary_es: Seguro médico gratis o de bajo costo para niños menores de 19 años.
summary_en: Free or low-cost health insurance for children under 19.

name: Public school enrollment
who_can_use: Children ages 4 to 21 living in the city.
status_note: Schools do not ask about immigration status.
bring: vaccination records if you have them
how_to_apply: Go to a Family Welcome Center with your child's documents.
summary_es: Todos los niños de 4 a 21 años tienen derecho a escuela pública gratis.
summary_en: Every child ages 4 to 21 has the right to free public school.

name: Students in temporary housing (transportation)
who_can_use: Students living in a shelter, doubled up with another family, or without a fixed home.
bring: nothing required; tell the school about your housing situation
how_to_apply: Tell the school or Family Welcome Center that your housing is temporary.
summary_es: Si su familia vive en albergue o con otra familia, sus hijos pueden recibir MetroCard o bus escolar.
summary_en: If your family lives in a shelter or with another family, your children can get a MetroCard or school bus.

name: Free immigration legal screening
who_can_use: Anyone who wants to understand their options, by appointment or walk-in.
status_note: Information and referrals only. A screening is not legal advice; a verified provider reviews your case.
bring: photo ID if you have one
how_to_apply: Call or walk in during screening hours at a free provider.
summary_es: Revisión gratis con un proveedor legal acreditado. Evite a los notarios: no pueden darle consejo legal.
summary_en: Free review with an accredited legal provider. Avoid notarios: they cannot give legal advice.
